rows.coder_note: Reread after gate failure: only one sentence of the row's passages describes the Fenland data in detail (10,708 participants, SomaScan v4, 4979 aptamers, 4775 proteins, citation 13); it was the sentence pinned in attempt 1 and it failed the gate, and no other sentence of the passages holds more. The N and platform it gives are shared by the two Fenland candidate rows. Its aptamer and protein counts, and the DOI linked to entry 13, belong to one of the two rows only, but the entry text itself prints neither a DOI nor a year. With no other sentence to pin, the row is left unresolved rather than forced; this evidence is noted for adjudication.

rows.quote: Using the SomaScan Multiple Aptamer Assay (version 4) in 35,559 Icelandic individuals with genotypic and phenotypic data, the deCODE study measured plasma protein levels [12], including 4,907 aptamers and 4,719 proteins.
rows.coder_note: Reread: sentence gives the deCODE study as SomaScan version 4 in exactly 35,559 Icelandic individuals with 4,907 aptamers, the N and platform of one dictionary row only; its citation 12 carries that row DOI.
